page.overview:
What is Acid Aerie?

The Acid Aerie was gorge located several days walk west of Blingdenstone.

The Acid Aerie was several hundred-foot-wide and filled with foul-smelling acid, the result of a wizard's experiment long ago. Several crisscrossing stone walkways of various widths allowed land-bound creatures to traverse the cavern and leave via the many tunnels that lined the walls, several of which lead into simple side-corridors or into the Wormwrithings.

The 'Aerie' part of its name was gained from a flock of dire corbies that inhabited the area, which were killed by Drizzt Do'Urden, Belwar Dissengulp, Clacker, and the spirit wraith of Zaknafein Do'Urden.
